# Varchasva Premier League (VPL) Season 2

Official digital hub and real-time database for the Varchasva Premier League (VPL) Season 2, a premier college cricket tournament.

---

## 📅 Tournament Overview
- **Dates**: May 29th, 2026 – June 1st, 2026
- **Location**: Saraswati Hall / Main Tournament Grounds, India
- **Sport**: Cricket (T20 Format)
- **Season**: Season 2 (S2)

---

## 🏆 Key Pages & Navigation Map
- **Homepage (`/`)**: Hub for current events, main sponsor integrations, and the match schedule.
- **Live Match Dashboard (`/live`)**: Real-time ball-by-ball score tracking, active bowler/batsman statistics, and innings commentary fed directly by live scorers.
- **Live Auction Hub (`/auction`)**: Elite dark-luxury broadcast board showcasing the live player auction, interactive bid-locking, dynamic team purse balances, and completed bidding logs.
- **Match Schedule (`/matches`)**: Complete schedule of all upcoming and completed fixtures.
- **Standings & Playoffs (`/points`)**: Three-group Points Table (Groups A, B, C) featuring auto-computed playoff seedings and a responsive tournament bracket.
- **Player & Leaderboard Stats (`/stats`)**: Live tournament leaderboards for batting average, strike rate, wickets, economics, and MVP points.
- **Team Squads (`/squads`)**: Roster directories of all active franchises in the tournament.

---

## 🤝 Partners & Sponsors
- **Proud Sponsors**:
  - **Patil Biryani**: Co-lead sponsor, featured on the homepage.
  - **Chitralaya Cineverse**: Co-lead sponsor, featured on the homepage.
- **Rewards Partner**:
  - **The Cafe Meraki**: Premium rewards partner, styled with a dedicated red glow badge on the homepage.

---

## ⚙️ Technical Stack
- **Framework**: Next.js (App Router, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript)
- **Data Layers**: Supabase PostgreSQL (Persistent Player, Match, and Team tables) & namespaced ioredis (Real-time live score updates and auction state caching)
- **Host**: Vercel
